decision.explanation: The provided sources present two distinct but valid positions held by Alfred Cannan. Document d1 describes him as a current Member of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey and specifically as the Representative of Istanbul's Beyoğlu district. These are both directly supported by the text and qualify as separate but complementary roles. Document d2 introduces another valid position—Minister for the Treasury of the Isle of Man—which is explicitly stated and supported by the narrative. Since these referents (Turkey vs. Isle of Man) are distinct and there is no contradiction between them, all three answers are retained as valid and complementary.
